tasks.name: Sauce Demo login + cart
tasks.goal: Open https://www.saucedemo.com, log in with the public standard_user / secret_sauce credentials, add Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart, open the cart, and confirm the backpack line item is present. Call done with a short summary.
tasks.acceptance: Cart shows Sauce Labs Backpack after login.

tasks.name: the-internet form auth + file download
tasks.goal: On https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/login authenticate with tomsmith / SuperSecretPassword!, then open /download, download any .txt file into the computer workspace, and confirm it appears under /workspace. Call done.
tasks.acceptance: Login success flash and a downloaded .txt under /workspace.

tasks.name: DemoQA practice form + upload
tasks.goal: Open the DemoQA practice form, fill required fields with plausible fake data, upload a small text file from /workspace (create one first if needed), submit the form, and confirm the modal summary. Call done.
tasks.acceptance: Submit modal shows filled name/email; upload attached.

tasks.name: books.toscrape extract to CSV
tasks.goal: Crawl the first page of https://books.toscrape.com, extract book title and price for every listed book, write a CSV to /workspace/books.csv with header title,price, and call done.

tasks.name: quotes.toscrape pagination
tasks.goal: Open https://quotes.toscrape.com, follow Next across at least 2 pages, collect ≥15 unique quotes (text + author), write /workspace/quotes.jsonl (one JSON object per line), and call done.

tasks.name: reCAPTCHA demo → takeover
tasks.goal: Open the Google reCAPTCHA v2 demo page. Do not attempt to solve the captcha. Call request_takeover with a clear reason so a human can complete it.
tasks.acceptance: request_takeover succeeds; agent pauses for human.

tasks.name: Multi-tab price/title compare
tasks.goal: Open two product pages in separate tabs (or sequential navigations with browser_tabs), read each title and price, write /workspace/compare.md with both rows and which is cheaper, then call done.
tasks.acceptance: compare.md lists both titles/prices and a cheaper verdict.

tasks.name: JS-heavy SPA click flow
tasks.goal: Open DemoQA dynamic properties. Wait until the 'Will enable 5 seconds' button becomes enabled, click it (or Visible After 5 Seconds), then navigate to /buttons and perform a double-click on the double-click button. Confirm the success message. Call done.
tasks.acceptance: Dynamic enable/visible handled; double-click success message seen.

tasks.name: Table sort and read
tasks.goal: Open the sortable table example, sort Example 1 by Due column, read the top row after sort, and write /workspace/table-top.json with lastName, firstName, due. Call done.
tasks.acceptance: table-top.json matches the first data row after Due sort.

tasks.name: Search + summarize
tasks.goal: On quotes.toscrape.com use the tag or search UX to find quotes tagged 'humor' (or filter via /tag/humor/), read at least 3 quotes, write a 2–3 sentence summary to /workspace/humor-summary.md, and call done.
tasks.acceptance: humor-summary.md exists and references ≥3 humor quotes.

tasks.name: Dropdown + date picker
tasks.goal: Open DemoQA date picker, set Select Date to 15 March 2030 via the calendar UI (not only typing if a picker is available), confirm the input shows that date, and call done.

tasks.name: Stop when spend cap hit
tasks.goal: NEGATIVE CASE: begin browsing example.com and keep taking tool steps. The run must stop because the per-task spend_cap_usd is hit — do not call done. This validates the cost meter kill switch.
tasks.acceptance: Task pauses with reason spend_cap before calling done.
